term.value: OPERATIVE LEASE is the Amended and Restated Lease dated 2/25/2015, which RELOCATED OfficeMax/Office Depot from the original ~30,000 SF box to a new 16,724 SF space — so the tenant has been at 16,724 SF since 2015 (the 1996 OfficeMax lease is fully superseded). The A&R Lease had a 10-year Initial Term (≈10/1/2015–9/30/2025) plus two 5-year options ($24.20 then $26.62/SF). Tenant gave a Non-Renewal Notice (3/14/2025) declining the options, so the lease was set to expire 9/30/2025; KPR then signed a 2025 First Amendment extending ONE year to 9/30/2026 at a below-option $19.50/SF. During this extension EITHER party may terminate on 120–150 days' notice, and KPR has access to market/tour the space — i.e., this is a true short-term, exit-track occupancy.

optionNotes: The A&R Lease's two 5-year options (Lease Years 11–15 at $24.20/SF and 16–20 at $26.62/SF) were DECLINED by Office Depot's 3/14/2025 Non-Renewal Notice. There is no remaining renewal right — the only forward term is the 1-year KPR extension to 9/30/2026 (terminable early by either side on 120–150 days' notice).

exclusives.description: No tenant USE-EXCLUSIVE located in the 2015 Amended & Restated Lease. The Permitted Use is any lawful retail purpose (Tenant's 'Current Use' is an office/consumer-supply store), and the lease carries Landlord zoning warranties supporting office-supply operation (§7.1.3) and a parking 'No Change Area' protection (§7.1.5) — but no covenant barring other office-supply uses in the Center. (The original 1996 OfficeMax lease HAD an office-supply exclusive; this relocation/A&R lease does not carry one.)

coTenancy.value: Ongoing Co-Tenancy (A&R Lease §2.6): King Soopers (or a Qualified Replacement) PLUS at least one additional 15,000+ SF retailer must be open and operating (≥80% of their premises). If not met (beyond 180-day remodel/casualty closures), Tenant may pay 50% Reduced Rent for up to 24 months and, failing cure within a further 12 months, terminate on 60 days' notice. No Opening Co-Tenancy. Currently satisfied (King Soopers + Marshalls/Michaels/PetSmart operating).

camTax.value: Tenant pays its pro-rata share of Shared Charges (CAM, taxes, insurance). For pro-rata math the Center Leasable Area never counts as less than a 220,000 SF 'Denominator Floor', which caps Tenant's share (its 16,724 SF over a floor of at least 220,000 SF). Detailed CAM inclusions/exclusions per the A&R Lease.

leaseNotes.label: Use Clause
leaseNotes.value: Any lawful retail purpose, or no use (go-dark permitted), subject to the Center's Restricted Uses (Schedule E-1). 'Current Use' = office/consumer-supply, furniture, equipment, electronics, school/teacher supplies, print/ship/business services, etc.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: None located in the 2015 A&R Lease. Permitted Use is any lawful retail; Landlord warrants zoning permits office-supply operation (§7.1.3) and protects Tenant's parking 'No Change Area' (§7.1.5), but there is NO covenant restricting other office-supply uses in the Center (the original 1996 OfficeMax lease had such an exclusive; this A&R lease does not).

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: Ongoing Co-Tenancy: King Soopers (or Qualified Replacement) + one 15,000+ SF retailer operating. If not met: 50% Reduced Rent up to 24 months; then a termination right. Currently satisfied.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: During the 1-year extension, Landlord (KPR) may terminate on 120–150 days' notice (2025 First Amendment §6) — KPR is actively marketing the space.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may terminate: (a) the extension on 120–150 days' notice (2025 First Amendment §6); (b) on a co-tenancy failure (§2.6); (c) if a zoning change forces it to cease operating as an office-supply/retail store (§7.1.3, §7.1.5); plus casualty/condemnation.

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center governed by recorded Declaration of Restrictions / REAs and the Restricted Uses schedule.

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Subject to the Center's Restricted Uses (Schedule E-1) and recorded restrictions.

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Tenant pays its pro-rata share of Shared Charges (CAM). For pro-rata math the Center Leasable Area never counts as less than a 220,000 SF 'Denominator Floor' (caps Tenant's share). Detailed CAM inclusions/exclusions per the A&R Lease.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata Shared Charge (220,000 SF Denominator Floor).

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata Shared Charge; Tenant to provide an insurance certificate for the extension term (2025 First Amendment §14).

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may sublease, license or assign AT ANY TIME WITHOUT Landlord consent (Art. 9). The original Tenant and assignees remain liable for the full term — EXCEPT the assignor is released if the assignee (or its guarantor) has tangible net worth over $75,000,000. Subleases/licenses are subordinate to the Lease and must comply with its use restrictions.

leaseNotes.label: Alterations
leaseNotes.value: Premises accepted 'as-is' for the extension; Landlord not obligated to perform/pay for any work (2025 First Amendment §3).

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: None — Permitted Use allows 'no use' (Tenant may go dark).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: No continuous-operation covenant — Tenant must open as an Office Depot/OfficeMax office-supply store for at least ONE day within 30 days of commencement, and need not operate thereafter (§2.8). BUT if Tenant ceases operating for 90 consecutive days (other than remodel/casualty/condemnation, or a permitted assignment/sublease whose tenant opens within 180 days), Landlord may TERMINATE and recapture on 60 days' notice (Tenant can defeat by reopening — or its assignee/subtenant opening — within 30 days of that notice).

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Tenant default (Art. 11): monetary default = 10 days after written notice; non-monetary = 30 days after notice (longer if not curable in 30 and Tenant diligently pursues); plus bankruptcy (120-day dismissal window). On an Event of Default, Landlord may (a) repossess WITHOUT terminating (relet for Tenant's account; Tenant liable for the deficiency, credited with re-letting rents) or (b) terminate (Tenant liable only to the termination date). Landlord must use reasonable efforts to relet/mitigate, and — importantly — may NOT accelerate rent or lock out/retake possession without due legal process and a court order; Landlord waives consequential and punitive damages.

leaseNotes.label: Guaranty
leaseNotes.value: None noted.

leaseNotes.label: Outparcel Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center governed by recorded Declaration of Restrictions / REAs and an access easement (Rec. No. 2002111229).

leaseNotes.label: Purchase Option / ROFR
leaseNotes.value: None noted.

leaseNotes.label: Holdover
leaseNotes.value: Month-to-month tenancy; holdover rent = 150% of the last month's Fixed Rent plus the same Additional Charges (Art. 11.2). (The current 1-year extension is itself an agreed short-term tail with mutual 120–150-day early-termination rights.)

leaseNotes.label: Relocation
leaseNotes.value: The 2015 A&R Lease WAS itself a relocation (from the original ~30,000 SF box to 16,724 SF).

leaseNotes.label: Utilities
leaseNotes.value: Per the A&R Lease (separately metered / tenant-paid).

leaseNotes.label: HVAC / Maintenance
leaseNotes.value: Landlord's existing maintenance obligations continue during the extension (2025 First Amendment §3).

leaseNotes.label: Pylon / Signage
leaseNotes.value: Per the A&R Lease; Tenant to remove signage on exit (2025 First Amendment §7).

leaseNotes.label: Subordination / SNDA
leaseNotes.value: No mortgage encumbered the Center at the lease date. Tenant subordinates to a future first-lien Institutional Mortgagee ONLY if the lender delivers an SNDA (Exhibit I form) — non-disturbance so long as Tenant isn't in default, lender assumes Landlord's obligations, Tenant attorns. Landlord represented (July 2025) no lender consent was needed for the extension.

leaseNotes.label: Estoppel
leaseNotes.value: Either party delivers an estoppel within 30 days of request (lease in force, modifications, rent paid-through, any violations) — relied on by purchasers/mortgagees/assignees (§12.6). Tenant also gave estoppel-type reps in the 2025 First Amendment §11 (lease in full force, no defaults/offsets).

flags.issue: Office Depot is on an EXIT track — non-renewed, now on a 1-year terminable extension (KPR marketing the space)
flags.detail: The operative lease is the 2/25/2015 Amended & Restated Lease (16,724 SF). Office Depot DECLINED its renewal options (Non-Renewal Notice 3/14/2025) and is occupying only under a 1-year KPR extension to 9/30/2026 at $19.50/SF, which EITHER party can end on 120–150 days' notice. KPR has the right to tour/market the space. Underwrite this as a near-term vacancy/re-tenanting opportunity (16,724 SF), not as in-place term. Note the 2025 First Amendment requires KPR to keep the termination/closing confidential from Office Depot store staff.

flags.issue: Bears directly on Michaels' co-tenancy — the OfficeMax/Office Depot anchor leg is leaving
flags.detail: Office Depot (the OfficeMax leg of Michaels' 3-anchor co-tenancy) is on an exit track (≤9/30/2026, possibly sooner). When it goes, Michaels falls to 2 of 3 (King Soopers + PetSmart) with no cushion — see the Michaels co-tenancy flag. A replacement for this 16,724 SF space that qualifies as an 'Anchor Tenant' under Michaels' lease (≥20 stores nationally / ≥7 regionally, or up to 2 tenants ≥21,000 SF / 70% of the OfficeMax space) would restore the cushion.

narrative: Office Depot (OfficeMax North America, Inc., an Ohio corporation; The ODP Corporation; store OMX #3362) occupies 16,724 SF at 2730 S Colorado Blvd in University Hills, Denver. The operative lease is the Amended & Restated Lease dated 2/25/2015, which relocated OfficeMax from the original ~30,000 SF box to this smaller 16,724 SF space — so the tenant has been at 16,724 SF since 2015 (the 1996 lease is fully superseded). The A&R Lease ran a 10-year term (~2015–2025) at $21.00→$22.00/SF with two 5-year options ($24.20, $26.62). Office Depot DECLINED renewal (Non-Renewal Notice 3/14/2025), so the lease was set to expire 9/30/2025; KPR then signed a First Amendment (7/23/2025) extending one year to 9/30/2026 at a below-option $19.50/SF ($326,118), with EITHER party able to terminate on 120–150 days' notice and KPR marketing the space. This is an exit-track, near-term vacancy — underwrite the 16,724 SF as a re-tenanting opportunity. It also matters for Michaels' co-tenancy: this OfficeMax leg is departing, dropping Michaels to 2 of 3 anchors. (This abstract corrects an earlier draft mistakenly built on the superseded 1996 OfficeMax lease.)
